go-pq-posture.sh (CI gate and host or image scan)

#!/bin/sh
# Usage: go-pq-posture.sh <dir-with-go-binaries>   (needs a Go toolchain on PATH)
# Fails if any Go binary is classical by build. Runtime GODEBUG must be checked separately.
rc=0
for f in $(find "$1" -type f -perm -u+x); do
  info=$(go version -m "$f" 2>/dev/null) || continue      # not a Go binary
  ver=$(echo "$info" | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*go1\.([0-9]+).*/\1/')
  dbg=$(echo "$info" | grep -o 'DefaultGODEBUG=[^ ]*')
  exp=$(echo "$info" | grep -o 'GOEXPERIMENT=[^ ]*')
  if [ "$ver" -lt 24 ]; then echo "FAIL $f go1.$ver: no ML-KEM"; rc=1
  elif echo "$dbg" | grep -q 'tlsmlkem=0'; then echo "FAIL $f go1.$ver: tlsmlkem=0 (go.mod go line < 1.24)"; rc=1
  elif echo "$exp" | grep -q boringcrypto; then echo "WARN $f boringcrypto: check for crypto/tls/fipsonly"
  elif echo "$dbg" | grep -q 'fips140=on' && [ "$ver" -lt 25 ]; then echo "FAIL $f go1.$ver FIPS: no PQ before 1.25"; rc=1
  else echo "OK   $f go1.$ver $dbg"; fi
done
exit $rc

To scan an image: docker create --name x <image>; docker cp x:/server ./scan/; docker rm x; ./go-pq-posture.sh ./scan. To scan EC2 hosts, run it through SSM Run Command on the binary folder.

Test harness and CI files added in this pass

These files produced the case C to I results above (outputs run-v2.out, run-v2b.out, run-v2c.out). They run in containers with the certificates under /certs.

go-pq-lint.sh (CI check: source, go.mod and IaC settings that block PQ)

#!/bin/sh
# go-pq-lint.sh [repo-dir]: source and IaC check for Go settings that block hybrid PQ key exchange.
# Exit 1 on any FAIL. Needs only sh, find and grep (run before the build; go-pq-posture.sh checks the binary).
dir=${1:-.}
out=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$out"' EXIT
fail() { echo "FAIL $*" >>"$out"; }

# 1. go line of every main module and go.work: < 1.24 means DefaultGODEBUG tlsmlkem=0
for m in $(find "$dir" \( -name go.mod -o -name go.work \) -not -path '*/vendor/*' -not -path '*/testdata/*'); do
  v=$(sed -n 's/^go \(1\.[0-9]*\).*/\1/p' "$m" | head -1); minor=${v#1.}
  if [ -n "$minor" ] && [ "$minor" -lt 24 ] && ! grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])tlsmlkem=1' "$m"; then
    fail "$m: 'go $v' (< 1.24) and no 'godebug tlsmlkem=1'"
  fi
  grep -nE 'tlsmlkem=0|tlssecpmlkem=0' "$m" | while read -r l; do fail "$m:$l"; done
done

# 2. Go source (tests excluded)
src=$(find "$dir" -name '*.go' -not -name '*_test.go' -not -path '*/vendor/*' -not -path '*/testdata/*')
for f in $src; do
  if grep -q 'CurvePreferences' "$f" && ! grep -qE 'MLKEM' "$f"; then
    grep -n 'CurvePreferences' "$f" | while read -r l; do fail "$f:$l  (CurvePreferences with no ML-KEM hybrid in this file)"; done
  fi
  grep -nE 'MaxVersion[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*tls\.VersionTLS1[0-2]' "$f" | while read -r l; do fail "$f:$l  (TLS 1.2 cap: no PQ)"; done
  grep -nE '^//go:debug.*(tlsmlkem=0|tlssecpmlkem=0|tlskyber)' "$f" | while read -r l; do fail "$f:$l"; done
  grep -nE 'crypto/tls/fipsonly' "$f" | while read -r l; do fail "$f:$l  (boringcrypto fipsonly: NIST curves only, no PQ)"; done
done

# 3. Deployment config: GODEBUG overrides and the retired go1.x Lambda runtime
for f in $(find "$dir" \( -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.tf' -o -name 'Dockerfile*' -o -name '*.service' -o -name '*.env' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/vendor/*'); do
  grep -nE 'tlsmlkem=0|tlssecpmlkem=0' "$f" | while read -r l; do fail "$f:$l  (GODEBUG turns PQ off)"; done
  grep -nE '(Runtime:[[:space:]]*go1\.x|runtime[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"go1\.x")' "$f" | while read -r l; do fail "$f:$l  (go1.x runtime retired: use provided.al2023)"; done
done

if [ -s "$out" ]; then cat "$out"; echo "go-pq-lint: $(wc -l <"$out" | tr -d ' ') finding(s)"; exit 1; fi
echo "go-pq-lint: OK ($dir)"

gen-certs.sh (test PKI: private CA, RSA and EC server certs, SNI certs, client certs, encrypted keys, PKCS#12)

#!/bin/sh
# Test PKI for the Go cases: private CA, RSA and EC server certs, SNI certs, client certs,
# encrypted keys (legacy PEM and PKCS#8) and PKCS#12 files (modern and legacy). Needs OpenSSL 3.
set -e
mkdir -p /certs/cadir; cd /certs
O=openssl
$O req -x509 -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -nodes -keyout ca.key -out ca.pem -days 3 \
  -subj "/CN=Test Private CA" -addext basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE -addext keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign
leaf() { # name alg san eku
  if [ "$2" = rsa ]; then $O req -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout $1.key -out $1.csr -subj "/CN=$1"
  else $O req -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -nodes -keyout $1.key -out $1.csr -subj "/CN=$1"; fi
  printf 'subjectAltName=%s\nextendedKeyUsage=%s\n' "$3" "$4" > $1.ext
  $O x509 -req -in $1.csr -CA ca.pem -CAkey ca.key -CAcreateserial -days 2 -extfile $1.ext -out $1.pem
}
leaf srv-rsa rsa DNS:localhost,DNS:pqsrv serverAuth
leaf srv-ec ec DNS:localhost,DNS:pqsrv serverAuth
leaf a.test ec DNS:a.test serverAuth
leaf b.test rsa DNS:b.test serverAuth
leaf cli-rsa rsa DNS:cli-rsa clientAuth
leaf cli-ec ec DNS:cli-ec clientAuth
# Encrypted keys: legacy "Proc-Type: 4,ENCRYPTED" PEM, and PKCS#8 "BEGIN ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY"
$O rsa -in srv-rsa.key -aes256 -traditional -passout pass:changeit -out srv-rsa-legacyenc.key
$O pkcs8 -topk8 -in srv-ec.key -v2 aes-256-cbc -passout pass:changeit -out srv-ec-pkcs8enc.key
# PKCS#12: OpenSSL 3 default (AES-256-CBC, PBKDF2, SHA-256 MAC) with chain; and legacy 3DES/SHA-1
$O pkcs12 -export -in srv-ec.pem -inkey srv-ec.key -certfile ca.pem -passout pass:changeit -out srv-ec-modern.p12
$O pkcs12 -export -in srv-rsa.pem -inkey srv-rsa.key -passout pass:changeit \
  -keypbe PBE-SHA1-3DES -certpbe PBE-SHA1-3DES -macalg sha1 -out srv-rsa-legacy.p12
cp ca.pem cadir/private-ca.pem

pq-servers.sh (the four OpenSSL 3.5 test servers)

#!/bin/sh
# pq-servers.sh: start the four OpenSSL 3.5 test servers (run in debian:trixie-slim after gen-certs.sh).
#   8443 PQ-only           8444 classical-only (TLS 1.2 and 1.3)
#   8445 PQ-only + mTLS    8446 classical-only + mTLS   (client cert must chain to ca.pem)
set -e
cd /certs
command -v openssl >/dev/null || { apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends openssl; }
srv() { port=$1; shift; openssl s_server -quiet -accept "$port" -cert srv-ec.pem -key srv-ec.key -www "$@" >/tmp/s"$port".log 2>&1 & }
srv 8443 -tls1_3 -groups X25519MLKEM768
srv 8444 -groups X25519:P-256
srv 8445 -tls1_3 -groups X25519MLKEM768 -Verify 1 -CAfile ca.pem
srv 8446 -groups X25519:P-256 -Verify 1 -CAfile ca.pem
sleep 1; echo "servers up: 8443 8444 8445 8446 (logs in /tmp/s<port>.log)"

cases/main.go (cases C, D, E, F, standard library only; build with a go.mod of module cases and the go line under test)

// cases: Go TLS case tests C, D, E, F with the standard library only.
// Compiles on Go 1.23+ (no tls.X25519MLKEM768 constant, no ConnectionState.CurveID needed).
//
//  cases client-default   D: nil RootCAs (system roots; runner sets SSL_CERT_FILE / SSL_CERT_DIR)
//  cases client           D, E, F client cases against the OpenSSL servers
//  cases server           C, E, F server cases on :9443..:9455 (probed with openssl s_client)
package main

import (
    "crypto/tls"
    "crypto/x509"
    "encoding/pem"
    "fmt"
    "log"
    "net"
    "os"
    "strings"
    "time"
)

const x25519mlkem768 = tls.CurveID(4588) // tls.X25519MLKEM768 from Go 1.24

var extraModes = map[string]func(){}

func p(f string) string { return "/certs/" + f }

func must[T any](v T, err error) T {
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    return v
}

func caPool() *x509.CertPool {
    pool := x509.NewCertPool()
    if !pool.AppendCertsFromPEM(must(os.ReadFile(p("ca.pem")))) {
        log.Fatal("no CA")
    }
    return pool
}

func pair(name string) tls.Certificate { return must(tls.LoadX509KeyPair(p(name+".pem"), p(name+".key"))) }

// Targets: OpenSSL 3.5 s_server instances started by the runner.
const (
    pqOnly       = "localhost:8443" // -tls1_3 -groups X25519MLKEM768
    classical    = "localhost:8444" // -groups X25519 (TLS 1.2 and 1.3)
    pqOnlyMTLS   = "localhost:8445" // PQ-only + -Verify 1 -CAfile ca.pem
    classicalMTL = "localhost:8446" // X25519 + -Verify 1 -CAfile ca.pem
)

func try(caseID, label, addr string, cfg *tls.Config) {
    if cfg.ServerName == "" {
        cfg.ServerName = "localhost"
    }
    c, err := tls.DialWithDialer(&net.Dialer{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}, "tcp", addr, cfg)
    if err != nil {
        e := err.Error()
        if len(e) > 110 {
            e = e[:110]
        }
        fmt.Printf("%s | %-44s | %-15s | FAIL | %s\n", caseID, label, addr, e)
        return
    }
    defer c.Close()
    // mTLS failures surface on first read in TLS 1.3, so read the -www reply.
    c.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second))
    fmt.Fprintf(c, "GET / HTTP/1.0\r\n\r\n")
    buf := make([]byte, 64)
    _, rerr := c.Read(buf)
    cs := c.ConnectionState()
    res := "OK  "
    extra := ""
    if rerr != nil && !strings.Contains(rerr.Error(), "EOF") {
        res, extra = "FAIL", " read: "+rerr.Error()
    }
    fmt.Printf("%s | %-44s | %-15s | %s | %s group=%s%s\n", caseID, label, addr, res, ver(cs.Version), curveName(cs), extra)
}

func ver(v uint16) string {
    switch v {
    case tls.VersionTLS13:
        return "TLS1.3"
    case tls.VersionTLS12:
        return "TLS1.2"
    }
    return fmt.Sprintf("%x", v)
}

func clientDefault() {
    label := os.Getenv("TRUST_LABEL")
    for _, a := range []string{pqOnly, classical} {
        try("D", "default RootCAs ("+label+")", a, &tls.Config{})
    }
}

func clientCases() {
    both := []string{pqOnly, classical}
    // D: custom trust
    for _, a := range both {
        pool, err := x509.SystemCertPool()
        if err != nil {
            pool = x509.NewCertPool()
        }
        pool.AppendCertsFromPEM(must(os.ReadFile(p("ca.pem"))))
        try("D", "SystemCertPool()+AppendCertsFromPEM(ca)", a, &tls.Config{RootCAs: pool})
        try("D", "RootCAs = NewCertPool with private CA only", a, &tls.Config{RootCAs: caPool()})
        try("D", "RootCAs = empty pool (negative)", a, &tls.Config{RootCAs: x509.NewCertPool()})
    }
    // E: mutual TLS
    rsaCli, ecCli := pair("cli-rsa"), pair("cli-ec")
    for _, a := range []string{pqOnlyMTLS, classicalMTL} {
        try("E", "Certificates=[client RSA]", a, &tls.Config{RootCAs: caPool(), Certificates: []tls.Certificate{rsaCli}})
        try("E", "GetClientCertificate -> client EC", a, &tls.Config{RootCAs: caPool(),
            GetClientCertificate: func(*tls.CertificateRequestInfo) (*tls.Certificate, error) { return &ecCli, nil }})
        try("E", "no client cert (negative)", a, &tls.Config{RootCAs: caPool()})
    }
    // F: explicit settings
    for _, a := range both {
        try("F", "CurvePreferences={X25519,P256}", a, &tls.Config{RootCAs: caPool(),
            CurvePreferences: []tls.CurveID{tls.X25519, tls.CurveP256}})
        try("F", "CurvePreferences={X25519MLKEM768,X25519,P256}", a, &tls.Config{RootCAs: caPool(),
            CurvePreferences: []tls.CurveID{x25519mlkem768, tls.X25519, tls.CurveP256}})
        try("F", "MaxVersion=TLS1.2", a, &tls.Config{RootCAs: caPool(), MaxVersion: tls.VersionTLS12})
        try("F", "MinVersion=TLS1.3", a, &tls.Config{RootCAs: caPool(), MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS13})
        try("F", "CipherSuites=2 ECDHE-GCM (TLS1.2 list)", a, &tls.Config{RootCAs: caPool(),
            CipherSuites: []uint16{tls.TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, tls.TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256}})
    }
}

// ---------- server side ----------

func serve(port int, label string, cfg *tls.Config) {
    ln, err := tls.Listen("tcp", fmt.Sprintf(":%d", port), cfg)
    if err != nil {
        log.Printf("port=%d case=%q LISTEN-ERROR %v", port, label, err)
        return
    }
    go func() {
        for {
            c, err := ln.Accept()
            if err != nil {
                return
            }
            go func(c net.Conn) {
                defer c.Close()
                tc := c.(*tls.Conn)
                tc.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second))
                if err := tc.Handshake(); err != nil {
                    log.Printf("port=%d case=%q handshake_error=%v", port, label, err)
                    return
                }
                cs := tc.ConnectionState()
                cn := "-"
                if len(cs.PeerCertificates) > 0 {
                    cn = cs.PeerCertificates[0].Subject.CommonName
                }
                log.Printf("port=%d case=%q %s group=%s sni=%q client_cn=%s", port, label, ver(cs.Version), curveName(cs), cs.ServerName, cn)
                tc.Write([]byte("HTTP/1.0 200 OK\r\n\r\nok\n"))
            }(c)
        }
    }()
}

// decryptLegacyPEM handles only RFC 1423 "Proc-Type: 4,ENCRYPTED" keys (deprecated API, still in stdlib).
func decryptLegacyPEM(keyFile, pass string) []byte {
    block, _ := pem.Decode(must(os.ReadFile(keyFile)))
    if block == nil || !x509.IsEncryptedPEMBlock(block) { //nolint:staticcheck
        log.Fatalf("%s: not a legacy encrypted PEM block", keyFile)
    }
    der := must(x509.DecryptPEMBlock(block, []byte(pass))) //nolint:staticcheck
    return pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: block.Type, Bytes: der})
}

func serverMain() {
    rsa, ec := pair("srv-rsa"), pair("srv-ec")
    a, b := pair("a.test"), pair("b.test")
    certs := func(c ...tls.Certificate) *tls.Config { return &tls.Config{Certificates: c} }

    serve(9443, "C rsa LoadX509KeyPair", certs(rsa))
    serve(9444, "C ec LoadX509KeyPair", certs(ec))
    serve(9445, "C Certificates=[rsa,ec]", certs(rsa, ec))
    serve(9446, "C Certificates=[ec,rsa]", certs(ec, rsa))
    serve(9447, "C SNI Certificates=[a.test,b.test]", certs(a, b))
    byName := map[string]*tls.Certificate{"a.test": &a, "b.test": &b}
    serve(9448, "C GetCertificate by SNI", &tls.Config{GetCertificate: func(h *tls.ClientHelloInfo) (*tls.Certificate, error) {
        if c, ok := byName[h.ServerName]; ok {
            return c, nil
        }
        return &ec, nil
    }})
    legacy := must(tls.X509KeyPair(must(os.ReadFile(p("srv-rsa.pem"))), decryptLegacyPEM(p("srv-rsa-legacyenc.key"), os.Getenv("TLS_KEY_PASS"))))
    serve(9449, "C encrypted legacy PEM key", certs(legacy))
    serve(9450, "E RequireAndVerifyClientCert", &tls.Config{Certificates: []tls.Certificate{ec},
        ClientAuth: tls.RequireAndVerifyClientCert, ClientCAs: caPool()})
    serve(9451, "F CurvePreferences={X25519,P256}", &tls.Config{Certificates: []tls.Certificate{ec},
        CurvePreferences: []tls.CurveID{tls.X25519, tls.CurveP256}})
    serve(9452, "F MaxVersion=TLS1.2", &tls.Config{Certificates: []tls.Certificate{ec}, MaxVersion: tls.VersionTLS12})
    serve(9453, "F CipherSuites=TLS1.2 ECDHE-GCM", &tls.Config{Certificates: []tls.Certificate{ec},
        CipherSuites: []uint16{tls.TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, tls.TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256}})
    serve(9454, "F PQ-only MinVersion1.3+{X25519MLKEM768}", &tls.Config{Certificates: []tls.Certificate{ec},
        MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS13, CurvePreferences: []tls.CurveID{x25519mlkem768}})
    envPair := must(tls.X509KeyPair([]byte(os.Getenv("TLS_CERT_PEM")), []byte(os.Getenv("TLS_KEY_PEM"))))
    serve(9455, "C cert+key PEM from env vars", certs(envPair))
    log.Printf("servers-up")
    select {}
}

func main() {
    log.SetFlags(0)
    log.SetOutput(os.Stdout)
    if f, ok := extraModes[os.Args[1]]; ok {
        f()
        return
    }
    switch os.Args[1] {
    case "client-default":
        clientDefault()
    case "client":
        clientCases()
    case "server":
        serverMain()
    }
}

cases/casei.go (case I: pinning and an opaque crypto.Signer key)

package main

// Case I: public-key pinning and a non-exportable signing key (crypto.Signer, as KMS/PKCS#11 wrappers expose).

import (
    "bytes"
    "crypto"
    "crypto/sha256"
    "crypto/tls"
    "crypto/x509"
    "errors"
    "fmt"
    "io"
    "log"
    "sync/atomic"
)

// opaqueSigner hides the concrete key type, like a KMS or PKCS#11 signer: only Public() and Sign().
type opaqueSigner struct {
    inner crypto.Signer
    calls atomic.Int32
}

func (s *opaqueSigner) Public() crypto.PublicKey { return s.inner.Public() }
func (s *opaqueSigner) Sign(r io.Reader, d []byte, o crypto.SignerOpts) ([]byte, error) {
    n := s.calls.Add(1)
    log.Printf("opaqueSigner.Sign call=%d key=%T hash=%v", n, s.inner, o.HashFunc())
    return s.inner.Sign(r, d, o)
}

var signer *opaqueSigner

func startCaseIServer() {
    for _, n := range []string{"srv-ec", "srv-rsa"} {
        c := pair(n)
        s := &opaqueSigner{inner: c.PrivateKey.(crypto.Signer)}
        c.PrivateKey = s
        port := 9456
        if n == "srv-rsa" {
            port = 9457
        }
        serve(port, "I crypto.Signer wrapper ("+n+")", &tls.Config{Certificates: []tls.Certificate{c}})
        if signer == nil {
            signer = s
        }
    }
}

func spkiPin(file string) []byte {
    c := pair(file)
    leaf, err := x509.ParseCertificate(c.Certificate[0])
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    h := sha256.Sum256(leaf.RawSubjectPublicKeyInfo)
    return h[:]
}

func pinned(pin []byte) *tls.Config {
    return &tls.Config{RootCAs: caPool(), VerifyConnection: func(cs tls.ConnectionState) error {
        h := sha256.Sum256(cs.PeerCertificates[0].RawSubjectPublicKeyInfo)
        if !bytes.Equal(h[:], pin) {
            return errors.New("SPKI pin mismatch")
        }
        return nil
    }}
}

func caseIClient() {
    good, bad := spkiPin("srv-ec"), spkiPin("srv-rsa") // OpenSSL servers use srv-ec
    for _, a := range []string{pqOnly, classical} {
        try("I", "VerifyConnection SPKI pin (correct)", a, pinned(good))
        try("I", "VerifyConnection SPKI pin (wrong, negative)", a, pinned(bad))
    }
}

func init() {
    extraModes["client-i"] = caseIClient
    extraModes["server-i"] = func() { startCaseIServer(); log.Printf("servers-up"); select {} }
    extraModes["signer-calls"] = func() { fmt.Println("n/a") }
}

deps/main.go (cases C (PKCS#12, encrypted PKCS#8) and H (AWS SDK, gRPC, pgx))

// deps: Go TLS cases that need third-party modules.
//
//  deps server     C: PKCS#12 (sslmate go-pkcs12, x/crypto/pkcs12) and encrypted PKCS#8 (youmark/pkcs8) on :9460..:9463
//  deps h          H: AWS SDK Go v2, grpc-go and pgx with a custom tls.Config (private CA + client cert)
//  deps h-awsenv   H: AWS SDK default client with AWS_CA_BUNDLE set by the runner
//
// Observers (in-process Go servers, PQ-only, mTLS required) log the negotiated group and client CN,
// so each library's handshake can be seen from the server side.
package main

import (
    "context"
    "crypto/tls"
    "crypto/x509"
    "encoding/pem"
    "fmt"
    "log"
    "net"
    "net/http"
    "os"
    "strings"
    "time"

    "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/aws"
    awshttp "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/aws/transport/http"
    "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/config"
    "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/credentials"
    "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/sts"
    "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
    "github.com/youmark/pkcs8"
    xpkcs12 "golang.org/x/crypto/pkcs12"
    "google.golang.org/grpc"
    grpccreds "google.golang.org/grpc/credentials"
    "google.golang.org/grpc/health"
    healthpb "google.golang.org/grpc/health/grpc_health_v1"
    "google.golang.org/grpc/peer"
    sslpkcs12 "software.sslmate.com/src/go-pkcs12"
)

func p(f string) string { return "/certs/" + f }

func must[T any](v T, err error) T {
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    return v
}

func caPool() *x509.CertPool {
    pool := x509.NewCertPool()
    pool.AppendCertsFromPEM(must(os.ReadFile(p("ca.pem"))))
    return pool
}

func pass() string { return os.Getenv("TLS_KEY_PASS") }

// ---------- C: PKCS#12 and encrypted PKCS#8 on the server ----------

func serve(port int, label string, cfg *tls.Config) {
    ln := must(tls.Listen("tcp", fmt.Sprintf(":%d", port), cfg))
    go func() {
        for {
            c, err := ln.Accept()
            if err != nil {
                return
            }
            go func(tc *tls.Conn) {
                defer tc.Close()
                tc.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second))
                if err := tc.Handshake(); err != nil {
                    log.Printf("port=%d case=%q handshake_error=%v", port, label, err)
                    return
                }
                cs := tc.ConnectionState()
                log.Printf("port=%d case=%q group=%s leaf=%s", port, label, cs.CurveID, cfg.Certificates[0].Leaf.Subject.CommonName)
                tc.Write([]byte("HTTP/1.0 200 OK\r\n\r\nok\n"))
            }(c.(*tls.Conn))
        }
    }()
}

func certFrom(key any, leaf *x509.Certificate, chain []*x509.Certificate) tls.Certificate {
    c := tls.Certificate{PrivateKey: key, Leaf: leaf, Certificate: [][]byte{leaf.Raw}}
    for _, ca := range chain {
        c.Certificate = append(c.Certificate, ca.Raw)
    }
    return c
}

func serverMain() {
    // 1. sslmate go-pkcs12: modern OpenSSL 3 PKCS#12 (AES-256-CBC, PBKDF2, SHA-256 MAC) with chain
    k, leaf, chain, err := sslpkcs12.DecodeChain(must(os.ReadFile(p("srv-ec-modern.p12"))), pass())
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatalf("sslmate modern: %v", err)
    }
    serve(9460, "C PKCS#12 modern via sslmate DecodeChain", &tls.Config{Certificates: []tls.Certificate{certFrom(k, leaf, chain)}})

    // 2. x/crypto/pkcs12 (frozen): legacy 3DES/SHA1 PKCS#12 works
    k2, leaf2, err := xpkcs12.Decode(must(os.ReadFile(p("srv-rsa-legacy.p12"))), pass())
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatalf("x/crypto legacy: %v", err)
    }
    serve(9461, "C PKCS#12 legacy via x/crypto Decode", &tls.Config{Certificates: []tls.Certificate{certFrom(k2, leaf2, nil)}})

    // 3. x/crypto/pkcs12 on the modern file: expected to fail at load time
    if _, _, err := xpkcs12.Decode(must(os.ReadFile(p("srv-ec-modern.p12"))), pass()); err != nil {
        log.Printf("case=%q load_error=%v", "C x/crypto Decode on modern PKCS#12", err)
    } else {
        log.Printf("case=%q loaded", "C x/crypto Decode on modern PKCS#12")
    }

    // 4. encrypted PKCS#8 ("BEGIN ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY") via youmark/pkcs8
    blk, _ := pem.Decode(must(os.ReadFile(p("srv-ec-pkcs8enc.key"))))
    k4 := must(pkcs8.ParsePKCS8PrivateKey(blk.Bytes, []byte(pass())))
    certBlk, _ := pem.Decode(must(os.ReadFile(p("srv-ec.pem"))))
    leaf4 := must(x509.ParseCertificate(certBlk.Bytes))
    serve(9462, "C encrypted PKCS#8 via youmark/pkcs8", &tls.Config{Certificates: []tls.Certificate{certFrom(k4, leaf4, nil)}})
    log.Printf("servers-up")
    select {}
}

// ---------- H: libraries with a custom tls.Config ----------

func clientCert() tls.Certificate { return must(tls.LoadX509KeyPair(p("cli-ec.pem"), p("cli-ec.key"))) }

func custom() *tls.Config {
    return &tls.Config{RootCAs: caPool(), Certificates: []tls.Certificate{clientCert()}, MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12}
}
func customBlocked() *tls.Config { // same, plus a classical-only curve list: proves the config is passed through
    c := custom()
    c.CurvePreferences = []tls.CurveID{tls.X25519, tls.CurveP256}
    return c
}

func observerCfg() *tls.Config {
    return &tls.Config{Certificates: []tls.Certificate{must(tls.LoadX509KeyPair(p("srv-ec.pem"), p("srv-ec.key")))},
        MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS13, CurvePreferences: []tls.CurveID{tls.X25519MLKEM768},
        ClientAuth: tls.RequireAndVerifyClientCert, ClientCAs: caPool()}
}

func cn(cs *tls.ConnectionState) string {
    if len(cs.PeerCertificates) == 0 {
        return "-"
    }
    return cs.PeerCertificates[0].Subject.CommonName
}

func startObservers() {
    // HTTPS observer for the AWS SDK
    mux := http.NewServeMux()
    mux.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        log.Printf("observer=https group=%s client_cn=%s ua=%.40s", r.TLS.CurveID, cn(r.TLS), r.UserAgent())
        w.WriteHeader(400)
    })
    hs := &http.Server{Addr: ":9470", Handler: mux, TLSConfig: observerCfg(), ErrorLog: log.New(os.Stdout, "observer=https ", 0)}
    go hs.ListenAndServeTLS("", "")

    // raw TLS observer for pgx (direct SSL negotiation)
    ln := must(tls.Listen("tcp", ":9471", observerCfg()))
    go func() {
        for {
            c, err := ln.Accept()
            if err != nil {
                return
            }
            go func(tc *tls.Conn) {
                defer tc.Close()
                tc.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second))
                if err := tc.Handshake(); err != nil {
                    log.Printf("observer=raw handshake_error=%v", err)
                    return
                }
                cs := tc.ConnectionState()
                log.Printf("observer=raw group=%s client_cn=%s alpn=%q", cs.CurveID, cn(&cs), cs.NegotiatedProtocol)
            }(c.(*tls.Conn))
        }
    }()

    // gRPC observer: PQ-only + mTLS
    glis := must(net.Listen("tcp", ":9472"))
    gs := grpc.NewServer(grpc.Creds(grpccreds.NewTLS(observerCfg())),
        grpc.UnaryInterceptor(func(ctx context.Context, req any, info *grpc.UnaryServerInfo, h grpc.UnaryHandler) (any, error) {
            if pr, ok := peer.FromContext(ctx); ok {
                if ti, ok := pr.AuthInfo.(grpccreds.TLSInfo); ok {
                    log.Printf("observer=grpc method=%s group=%s client_cn=%s", info.FullMethod, ti.State.CurveID, cn(&ti.State))
                }
            }
            return h(ctx, req)
        }))
    healthpb.RegisterHealthServer(gs, health.NewServer())
    go gs.Serve(glis)

    // gRPC observer without mTLS, for NewClientTLSFromFile
    glis2 := must(net.Listen("tcp", ":9473"))
    oc := observerCfg()
    oc.ClientAuth = tls.NoClientCert
    gs2 := grpc.NewServer(grpc.Creds(grpccreds.NewTLS(oc)))
    healthpb.RegisterHealthServer(gs2, health.NewServer())
    go gs2.Serve(glis2)
    time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond)
}

func verdict(err error) string {
    if err == nil {
        return "TLS-OK"
    }
    s := err.Error()
    if len(s) > 150 {
        s = s[len(s)-150:]
    }
    if strings.Contains(s, "tls:") || strings.Contains(s, "handshake") || strings.Contains(s, "remote error") || strings.Contains(s, "x509:") {
        return "TLS-FAIL: " + s
    }
    return "TLS-OK, then protocol error: " + s
}

func short() context.Context { c, _ := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 6*time.Second); return c }

func awsCall(hc config.HTTPClient, endpoint string, extra ...func(*config.LoadOptions) error) error {
    opts := []func(*config.LoadOptions) error{config.WithRegion("us-east-1"),
        config.WithCredentialsProvider(credentials.NewStaticCredentialsProvider("AKIDEXAMPLE", "secret", "")),
        config.WithRetryMaxAttempts(1)}
    if hc != nil {
        opts = append(opts, config.WithHTTPClient(hc))
    }
    opts = append(opts, extra...)
    ac, err := config.LoadDefaultConfig(context.Background(), opts...)
    if err != nil {
        return fmt.Errorf("config: %w", err)
    }
    cl := sts.NewFromConfig(ac, func(o *sts.Options) { o.BaseEndpoint = aws.String(endpoint) })
    _, err = cl.GetCallerIdentity(short(), &sts.GetCallerIdentityInput{})
    return err
}

func pgxCall(dsn string, cfg *tls.Config) error {
    pc, err := pgx.ParseConfig(dsn)
    if err != nil {
        return fmt.Errorf("parse: %w", err)
    }
    if cfg != nil {
        cfg.ServerName = pc.Host
        pc.TLSConfig = cfg
        pc.Fallbacks = nil
    }
    c, err := pgx.ConnectConfig(short(), pc)
    if c != nil {
        c.Close(context.Background())
    }
    return err
}

func grpcCall(addr string, creds grpccreds.TransportCredentials) error {
    conn, err := grpc.NewClient(addr, grpc.WithTransportCredentials(creds))
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }
    defer conn.Close()
    _, err = healthpb.NewHealthClient(conn).Check(short(), &healthpb.HealthCheckRequest{})
    return err
}

func h() {
    startObservers()
    pr := func(lib, label, target string, err error) {
        fmt.Printf("H | %-8s | %-52s | %-22s | %s\n", lib, label, target, verdict(err))
    }
    // AWS SDK for Go v2
    buildable := func(cfg func() *tls.Config) *awshttp.BuildableClient {
        return awshttp.NewBuildableClient().WithTransportOptions(func(t *http.Transport) { t.TLSClientConfig = cfg() })
    }
    plain := &http.Client{Transport: &http.Transport{TLSClientConfig: custom()}}
    for _, ep := range []string{"https://localhost:9470", "https://localhost:8445", "https://localhost:8446"} {
        pr("aws-sdk", "BuildableClient, TLSClientConfig=custom", ep, awsCall(buildable(custom), ep))
        pr("aws-sdk", "plain *http.Client{Transport: TLSClientConfig=custom}", ep, awsCall(plain, ep))
        pr("aws-sdk", "BuildableClient, custom + CurvePreferences{X25519,P256}", ep, awsCall(buildable(customBlocked), ep))
    }
    pr("aws-sdk", "default client + WithCustomCABundle (no client cert)", "https://localhost:8443",
        awsCall(nil, "https://localhost:8443", config.WithCustomCABundle(must(os.Open(p("ca.pem"))))))
    pr("aws-sdk", "plain *http.Client + WithCustomCABundle", "https://localhost:8443",
        awsCall(&http.Client{Transport: &http.Transport{}}, "https://localhost:8443", config.WithCustomCABundle(must(os.Open(p("ca.pem"))))))

    // grpc-go
    pr("grpc", "credentials.NewTLS(custom)", "localhost:9472", grpcCall("localhost:9472", grpccreds.NewTLS(custom())))
    pr("grpc", "credentials.NewTLS(custom + CurvePreferences{X25519,P256})", "localhost:9472", grpcCall("localhost:9472", grpccreds.NewTLS(customBlocked())))
    pr("grpc", "credentials.NewClientTLSFromFile(ca.pem)", "localhost:9473", grpcCall("localhost:9473", must(grpccreds.NewClientTLSFromFile(p("ca.pem"), "localhost"))))

    // pgx v5 (direct SSL negotiation so the TLS handshake is the first thing on the wire)
    for _, port := range []string{"9471", "8445", "8446"} {
        base := "postgres://app@localhost:" + port + "/app?sslnegotiation=direct&connect_timeout=5&sslmode=verify-full"
        pr("pgx", "ConnConfig.TLSConfig=custom", "localhost:"+port, pgxCall(base, custom()))
        pr("pgx", "DSN sslrootcert+sslcert+sslkey", "localhost:"+port,
            pgxCall(base+"&sslrootcert=/certs/ca.pem&sslcert=/certs/cli-ec.pem&sslkey=/certs/cli-ec.key", nil))
        pr("pgx", "ConnConfig.TLSConfig=custom + CurvePreferences{X25519,P256}", "localhost:"+port, pgxCall(base, customBlocked()))
    }
    time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond)
}

func hAwsEnv() {
    // AWS_CA_BUNDLE is read by LoadDefaultConfig.
    pr := func(label string, err error) {
        fmt.Printf("H | aws-sdk  | %-52s | %-22s | %s\n", label, "https://localhost:8443", verdict(err))
    }
    pr("default client + AWS_CA_BUNDLE env", awsCall(nil, "https://localhost:8443"))
    pr("plain *http.Client + AWS_CA_BUNDLE env", awsCall(&http.Client{Transport: &http.Transport{}}, "https://localhost:8443"))
}

func main() {
    log.SetFlags(0)
    log.SetOutput(os.Stdout)
    switch os.Args[1] {
    case "server":
        serverMain()
    case "h":
        h()
    case "h-awsenv":
        hAwsEnv()
    }
}

Python

Problem statement

A Python service that runs on the wrong base image talks classical TLS today: it negotiates X25519 or P-256 with no ML-KEM, so traffic it sends or receives can be recorded now and decrypted later by a quantum computer (harvest-now-decrypt-later). Nothing fails, so nobody notices. Python itself has no PQ switch. The handshake is controlled by whichever TLS library each package uses:

  • The ssl family (ssl, http.client, urllib, requests, urllib3, boto3/botocore, httpx, aiohttp, redis-py, PyMySQL, uvicorn, gunicorn, hypercorn): the OpenSSL that the interpreter links, from the base image or host, plus that OpenSSL's config (OPENSSL_CONF, the AL2023 crypto policy). PQ needs OpenSSL 3.5+ with ML-KEM in the group list.
  • Wheels that bundle their own TLS (grpcio, awscrt, confluent-kafka, psycopg [binary], psycopg2-binary, pyOpenSSL via cryptography): the wheel version. Current wheels are already PQ on every base image tested.

The fix for most teams is a base-image change or one environment variable. Existing certificates, key files, PKCS#12 stores and CA bundles do not change: key exchange is negotiated separately from the certificate (cases C and D, Tested).

In Python the TLS library, not the Python version, decides whether a connection offers X25519MLKEM768. There are two families, and each package belongs to one of them:

Family Packages Who controls the key exchange PQ when
Linked to the system OpenSSL through the ssl module ssl, http.client, urllib, requests, urllib3, boto3/botocore (default), httpx, aiohttp, redis-py, PyMySQL, uvicorn, gunicorn, hypercorn, Flask/Django/FastAPI servers The OpenSSL the interpreter links (base image or host) plus its config (OPENSSL_CONF, AL2023 crypto policy) OpenSSL 3.5+ and the config keeps ML-KEM in the group list
Bundles its own TLS library in the wheel grpcio (BoringSSL), awscrt (s2n-tls + AWS-LC), confluent-kafka (static OpenSSL 3.5.8 in librdkafka 2.16.0), psycopg[binary] and psycopg2-binary (their own libpq + libssl), pyOpenSSL (the OpenSSL in the cryptography wheel) The wheel version Already PQ in current wheels, on any base image, including Debian 12 with OpenSSL 3.0 (Tested)

So the first question for any service is which family each outbound connection uses. A requests call on Debian 12 is classical, while a grpcio call from the same container is PQ.

Python 3.15 (released 9 Oct 2026) adds SSLContext.set_groups(), get_groups() and SSLSocket.group(). These let code set the group list and log the negotiated group. Older versions have no group API: set_ecdh_curve("X25519MLKEM768") raises ValueError: unknown elliptic curve name on 3.12, 3.13 and 3.15 (Tested). See the 3.15 ssl docs.

Versions and native support

PQ depends on the OpenSSL under Python, so the same Python version gives different answers on Lambda, in a container and on EC2.

FIPS mode for the ssl family (AL2023 in FIPS mode, or a FIPS OpenSSL provider) was not tested here. Whether the FIPS provider offers ML-KEM is not confirmed; see case G.

Decision guide:

  • Base image is python:*-slim-trixie or python:*-alpine (3.24): nothing to do for any case below except F (code that pins old settings).
  • Lambda python3.12 to 3.15, a Lambda image, or anything on AL2023: ship openssl-pq.cnf and set OPENSSL_CONF, or set DEFAULT:PQ on the host or image.
  • Lambda python3.9 to 3.11: upgrade the runtime. If you cannot yet, the legacy shim covers requests and boto3 only.
  • python:*-bookworm, Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 or AL2 hosts: OpenSSL is too old. Change the base image or OS; no setting helps.
  • The service only uses grpcio, awscrt, confluent-kafka or psycopg binary: already PQ; check the peer.
  • You load your own certificate, key, PKCS#12 or CA bundle: keep it. Only the platform fix above applies (cases C, D, E).
